name: Example Journal
notes: This is a template, not a real journal. Copy it, rename it, and edit the numbers to match the journal you are submitting to.
_how_to_use: Copy this file and rename it after the journal, e.g. microbiome.json.
Set 'verified' to the date you actually read the journal's guidelines.
Set 'guidelines_url' so anyone using the profile can check it themselves.
Delete any limit you don't want checked; nothing here is required.
reference_style is 'numbered' or 'author_year', or leave it out.
Limits Galley understands: abstract_words, main_text_words, total_words,
Galley ships no real journal profiles, because a stale limit is worse
than none. If you build one for your journal, a pull request is welcome.
